name: Thomas Klepach
abstract_title: Beyond Gap Junctions: The Synaptic Glycocalyx, Perineuronal Nets, and Actin Tensegrity as Resonant Dielectric Bridges for Intercellular Quantum Coherence
abstract: Recent advances in quantum neurobiology suggest that macromolecular quantum processes play a foundational role in conscious experience. Central to this hypothesis is the capacity of the aqueous solvent to support quantum coherence at physiological temperatures. While the sequestered water within the microtubule lattice has been proposed as a protected quantum-coherent reservoir (Orch OR), the mechanism for intercellular propagation remains a significant explanatory gap.
